annotation.evidence_span: If one or more encodings have been applied to a representation, the sender that applied the encodings MUST generate a Content-Encoding header field that lists the content codings in the order in which they were applied.
annotation.interpretation_a: The header must list all content codings that have been applied to the representation, regardless of which sender applied them.
annotation.interpretation_b: The header must list only the content codings that were applied by the sender that is currently transmitting the representation.
annotation.justification: The clause does not specify whether the header must include all codings applied to the representation or only those applied by the current sender, creating an incomplete constraint that could lead to materially different implementation behaviours.
